metaDescription: Kevin reacts to the Leah Files and Shawn Ryan podcast dispute, then profiles Anduril, Palmer Luckey, and Peter Thiel's Lord of the Rings-themed companies.
summary: This livestream covers the dispute between the Leah Files and Shawn Ryan, plus Kevin's research on Anduril, Palmer Luckey, and Peter Thiel's network. Kevin argues that people should say "asset" rather than "Fed" and that nobody has to pick a side. He reports that Leah alleges she was told not to discuss Founders Fund or A16Z, and says Shawn Ryan invested in Anduril. Kevin plays her Flock Safety segment, reads his Panopticon Index dossier on Anduril, and notes Thiel-linked firms with Lord of the Rings names. He also mentions the failed Glorifi bank, a Metallica show, and dog fostering.
